SELECT COUNT(*) AS focused_alpha_leaders
FROM funds f
JOIN risk_metrics r ON r.investmentref = f.tickersym
JOIN (SELECT instrumentref, MAX(holdingpct) AS top_weight
      FROM holdings GROUP BY instrumentref) h ON h.instrumentref = f.tickersym
WHERE r.alpha5y > 0 AND h.top_weight > 0.08

WITH fund_amv AS (
  SELECT f.tickersym,
         (r.avgreturn3y - p.benchr3y) / r.volatility3y - (f.expensenet - f.benchmarkexp) * 10 AS amv_score
  FROM funds f
  JOIN risk_metrics r ON r.investmentref = f.tickersym
  JOIN performance p ON p.productref = f.tickersym
  WHERE r.avgreturn3y IS NOT NULL AND p.benchr3y IS NOT NULL
    AND r.volatility3y IS NOT NULL AND r.volatility3y <> 0
    AND f.expensenet IS NOT NULL AND f.benchmarkexp IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT tickersym,
       ROUND(amv_score::numeric, 4) AS amv,
       (SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE amv_score > 0) / COUNT(*), 4) FROM fund_amv)
         AS pct_funds_with_positive_amv
FROM fund_amv
ORDER BY amv_score DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT f.productclass,
       COUNT(*) AS fund_count,
       ROUND(regr_slope(r.alpha3y, f.turnoverratio)::numeric, 4) AS alpha_turnover_slope,
       ROUND(regr_r2(r.alpha3y, f.turnoverratio)::numeric, 4) AS fit_quality
FROM funds f
JOIN risk_metrics r ON r.investmentref = f.tickersym
WHERE r.alpha3y IS NOT NULL AND f.turnoverratio IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY f.productclass
HAVING COUNT(*) > 25
ORDER BY alpha_turnover_slope DESC
LIMIT 100

SELECT ROUND(AVG(((r.avgreturn3y - p.benchr3y) / NULLIF(r.volatility3y, 0))
                * (p.positiveyears / NULLIF(p.positiveyears + p.negativeyears, 0)))::numeric, 2)
         AS avg_consistency_adjusted_information_ratio
FROM risk_metrics r
JOIN performance p ON p.productref = r.investmentref

SELECT f.tickersym,
       f.shortlabel,
       ROUND((p.lowdelta / NULLIF(p.high52w - p.low52w, 0) * 100)::numeric, 8) AS price_position
FROM funds f
JOIN performance p ON p.productref = f.tickersym
WHERE p.lowdelta / NULLIF(p.high52w - p.low52w, 0) * 100 < 25
  AND f.turnoverratio < 0.3
  AND (f.expensenet - f.benchmarkexp) < 0
ORDER BY price_position ASC
LIMIT 100

WITH hq AS (
  SELECT ba.fundlink,
         SUM(CASE WHEN br.credit_scoringmark IN ('us_government', 'aaa', 'aa')
                  THEN ba.allocationpct ELSE 0 END) AS hq_allocation
  FROM bond_allocations ba
  JOIN bond_ratings br ON br.ratekey = ba.ratinglink
  GROUP BY ba.fundlink
)
SELECT f.tickersym,
       f.shortlabel,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (f.yieldrate / f.expensenet) * hq.hq_allocation DESC) AS premier_rank,
       (f.yieldrate / f.expensenet) * hq.hq_allocation AS secure_income_efficiency_score
FROM funds f
JOIN hq ON hq.fundlink = f.tickersym
WHERE f.yieldrate / NULLIF(f.expensenet, 0) > 15
  AND hq.hq_allocation > 0.6
ORDER BY secure_income_efficiency_score DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN f.pe_ratio IS NOT NULL AND f.pb_ratio IS NOT NULL
            THEN 'Transparent' ELSE 'Opaque' END AS transparency_group,
       COUNT(*) AS fund_count,
       ROUND((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.r1y))::numeric, 4) AS median_1y_return
FROM funds f
JOIN performance p ON p.productref = f.tickersym
GROUP BY 1

WITH yearly AS (
  SELECT calendaryear, fundperf - categoryperf AS outperformance
  FROM annual_returns
  WHERE portfolioref = 'AADR'
)
SELECT calendaryear,
       outperformance,
       LAG(outperformance) OVER (ORDER BY calendaryear) AS prev_year_outperformance,
       outperformance - LAG(outperformance) OVER (ORDER BY calendaryear) AS yoy_outperformance_change
FROM yearly
ORDER BY calendaryear
